text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: multi-gpu NCCL rendezvous failures observed in cluster 'inference-prod-2' -- 8xA100 jobs failing to enter allreduce. Error rate spiked at 17:33 UTC. Paging oncall.
alex (oncall-ml): I'm on it. seeing repeated `NCCL comm timeout` and `NCCL ERROR NET/SHM`. Jobs are stuck in tensor/pipeline parallel init.
sara (infra): any kernel XID or container crash logs? I can preemptively cordon a node if it's flapping.
micah (runtime): attaching recent logs, looks like GPUs on node gpu-42 had CUDA Xid 79 then container restart. snippet: ```[2026-03-15T17:32:54Z] NCCL WARN Call to recv timed out rank 3->5
[2026-03-15T17:32:54Z] NCCL ERROR Unhandled error, aborting
[2026-03-15T17:32:55Z] cuda: Xid 79, GPU fault, process 11234 (model-server)
[2026-03-15T17:32:56Z] containerd: task exited with status 137
```
alex (oncall-ml): thanks. root cause likely GPU driver fault causing communicator to drop. Are only pipeline-parallel jobs affected or allcollectives?
micah (runtime): mostly pipeline/tensor parallel. Single-GPU and small-data-parallel jobs mostly unaffected. When one rank died, NCCL rendezvous didn't fallback cleanly, leaving other tasks hung.
sara (infra): cordoning gpu-42 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-42` and draining non-critical pods. Will also set node unschedulable to prevent new job scheduling.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Node gpu-42 cordoned by sara at 17:36 UTC.
alex (oncall-ml): immediate mitigations: 1) abort affected jobs to unblock capacity, 2) restart crashed containers on other nodes to reset NCCL communicators, 3) enable single-rank fallback for long-run jobs. Devon, can you take the customer comms once we know impact?
devon (day-oncall): I can. please DM me the customer list.
micah (runtime): commands I'm running: ```# increase NCCL timeout
kubectl set env deploy/model-server NCCL_TIMEOUT=300
# enable debug logs temporarily
kubectl set env deploy/model-server NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
# restart affected pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-server -n inference-prod
```
alex (oncall-ml): doing a controlled abort of the 8 affected pipeline jobs to allow safe restart. abort commands issued at 17:38.
sara (infra): noticed node gpu-42 also has NVLink errors in dmesg. collecting kernel logs: ```Mar 15 17:32:50 gpu-42 kernel: NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU fault: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus
Mar 15 17:32:51 gpu-42 kernel: nvidia 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus```. Escalating to hardware ops for replacement.
alex (oncall-ml): immediate customer impact: some customer inference jobs in reserved capacity saw failures/long hangs (~2-3m timeouts on client side). Not a broad outage but visible errors for a handful of enterprise jobs.
devon (day-oncall): noted. drafting brief customer note: "We observed a multi-GPU communicator failure affecting a subset of pipeline-parallel jobs. We're mitigating and will share timeline." Will send to customers once we have final remediation ETA.
micah (runtime): rolling restart completed on remaining replicas at 17:43. Observed one more container OOM in a different node; increased memory limits on job controller for heavy pipeline jobs as a stopgap.
sara (infra): hardware ops confirmed GPU replacement ticket created (HW-7892). In the meantime I've cordoned gpu-42 and drained all noncritical GPU workloads. Scheduling note: moving high-parallelism jobs to other racks with verified NVLink health.
alex (oncall-ml): post-mitigation checks: 1) verify no NCCL orphaned communicators, 2) ensure KV cache warmup isn't causing overcommit, 3) fall back to model-sharded single-GPU configs for high-risk jobs.
micah (runtime): added a temporary runtime guard: if any rank fails during rendezvous, autos-abort and backoff to single-rank fallback. Pushed change to runtime at 17:50 (quick patch).
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Patch deployed to inference runtime at 17:50 UTC.
alex (oncall-ml): monitoring for 20m window. telemetry shows error rate back to baseline at 17:57. latency saw a 10% spike while restarts/heavy rescheduling completed.
devon (day-oncall): customer note sent to impacted accounts at 18:05 UTC: brief summary + statement we will follow up with root cause and timeline for permanent fix.
sara (infra): leaving cordon in place until hardware swap completes. marking node gpu-42 as unschedulable.
micah (runtime): followups: need a proper graceful abort path in runtime so NCCL abort doesn't leave jobs hung; add better health-check gating before pipeline launch; add early-detect NVLink/driver XID alerts to preempt scheduling.
alex (oncall-ml): agree. creating follow-up tasks and tagging owners. Will own incident write-up draft.
devon (day-oncall): taking ownership of customer comms and follow-up. Handoff complete to daytime oncall.
alex (oncall-ml): handoff notes: root cause -> one GPU experienced a driver-level Xid 79 causing container exit; NCCL rendezvous didn't tolerate mid-rendezvous rank death and hung other ranks. Mitigation -> cordon/drain node, abort affected pipeline jobs, restart remaining pods, temporary runtime patch for graceful fallback, hardware ticket opened. Impact -> limited to subset of pipeline-parallel jobs; some enterprise reserved jobs returned errors/latency spikes.
sara (infra): assigning HW ticket to ops-team.
micah (runtime): adding a short diagnostic playbook snippet to repo: ```- if NCCL timeout > threshold: check dmesg for Xid, check container exit codes, cordon node, abort job, restart runtime, escalate to infra```
alex (oncall-ml): closing pager. leaving thread for notes and postmortem. Please add reactions for anything to include in postmortem. :thumbsup:
